name: express-mvc-starter
description: Node.js Express project with MVC structure

__comments.scripts: The 'start' script runs the server normally for production. The 'dev' script uses nodemon to auto-restart the server during development when files change.
__comments.dependencies: Express is the core web framework. Dotenv loads environment variables from the .env file.
__comments.devDependencies: Morgan logs HTTP requests to the console for debugging. Nodemon watches for file changes.
